name: Luminar
sub: Long-range LiDAR that reached production on the Volvo EX90
regions: Historical programs in US, Europe, China
leadership: Paul Ricci became CEO in 2025; Austin Russell founded company
about: Former leading long-range automotive LiDAR pure play; current status is distressed/historical after Volvo termination, bankruptcy and asset sales.
model: Historically sold LiDAR hardware and software to OEMs; current standalone operating model impaired.
financing: Public; ~$748M raised across private and SPAC eras; entered an asset-sale process in January 2026 with MicroVision as prospective buyer of assets
deployment: Volvo EX90 was the flagship production path, but Volvo ended the relationship
metrics: Chapter 11 filed 15 December 2025; liquidation plan filed; semiconductor unit sold for $110M.
signal: Filed Chapter 11 on 15 Dec 2025 with ~$488M of debt after losing the Volvo contract; filed a liquidation plan and sold their semiconductor subsidiary to Quantum Computing for $110M.

sources.title: Luminar Technologies Initiates Voluntary Chapter 11 Proceedings to Facilitate Value-Maximizing Sale Process
